notes.title: FREERIDE IS OUT NOW! 🚂
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Just in case you hadn’t noticed…

[h1]Freeride is OUT NOW!!![/h1]

[previewyoutube=3pLQwmrcE68;full]INSERT YT LINK[/previewyoutube]

This game has been a dream of mine for over 10 years, so to see it finished and ready to play is actually surreal. 🚂✨✨✨

You can expect:
[list]
[*] An adventure you just can’t say ‘No’ to!
[*] Highly branching storyline where your subconscious personality determines the ending.
[*] Strange cast of characters with serious baggage (not just the kind aboard the train).
[*] Love, loss, betrayal, and friendship.
[*] A PERSONALITY TEST to find out who YOU really are
[/list]

I’ll leave you to experience this world for yourselves now, I really hope you enjoy it!

We promise not to judge you, and the Seer will try her best ⭐

- Rebecca & The Flightyfelon Team

notes.title: 🌻Wholesome Games Feature🌻, Release Window, Brand New Trailer, and NEXT FEST!!!
notes.content:
Rebecca from Flightyfelon Games here, with some exciting news I’ve been dying to share with you all:

[h1]We were part of this summer’s Wholesome Games Direct![/h1]

This means we’ve got a shiny new trailer (you can watch it below!) which shows some never-before-seen footage of Acts 2, 3 and Intermission! 

[previewyoutube=FyPraUZnUsI;full][/previewyoutube]

You may have also noticed that we surprise released the demo on Nintendo Switch during the Direct, which has been a goal for us for a long time. 
*It’s still only out on the European store for red-tape reasons, but all accounts will have access soon!

We’re also taking part in the Women-Led Games Steam event, so be sure to check out both Freeride and all the other amazing games created by women-led and women-majority teams. :D

Following all of this, Freeride will be hopping into Steam Next Fest in a couple of days, so if you’ve not played the demo yet (or you fancy another loop to find out if you’re a Friend or a Clown) then now is the perfect time!
🚂✨✨✨

[h1]New Co-Publisher![/h1]
Future Friends Games is now working with us to get Freeride in your hands. You may know them as the publisher of games like Europa, SUMMERHOUSE, Omno, Gourdlets, or Exo One. Please give them a warm welcome. <3 

[h1]Release Window[/h1]
And last but certainly not least: Freeride will be released in Q1 of 2025! 
There’s still lots of work to do until then, but with the support of players like you we are filled with motivation. With the incredible community on Discord, and all the amazing comments you’ve sent our way on social media – we feel so lucky to be sharing this game with all of you!

[h1]Your Feedback[/h1]
We’ve got our ears peeled like Solo’s – tell us what you’d love to know about Freeride after this trailer here/on our Discord/on our socials (TikTok, Twitter/X, Instagram/Threads). :) We’re happy to sate your curiosities (unless they involve Ajo’s ice cream flavors). 

That’s it for now, we can’t wait to show more as we draw closer to the release window! Take care and don’t forget that Freeride is watching you as you play…, we’ve got our eyes on you, you sillies. 🤡

May you solve your Unfinished Business, 

-The Flightyfelon Games Team

notes.title: One year of FREERIDE Demo, and what’s next!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hi everyone!![/b][/h2]
✨Rebecca from Flightyfelon Games here. ✨

This is our first news post in almost a year, woo!! Please look forward to these regularly becoming a thing from now on. We’re so happy that we have such a passionate community on our [url=https://discord.gg/DDQFFmyRGF]Discord[/url], but we want to show some love to the fine folks following FREERIDE on Steam, too. 

Here, you can anticipate a monthly update on the state of the game and maaaybe other surprises! We’re going to have fun with this. 

First things first: This year we’ve been included in the upcoming ‘Storytellers Festival’, kicking off on the 29th Jan (hey, that’s today)! It’s amazing to be featured alongside so many other gorgeous narrative games. 

Make sure you keep your eyes peeled for this shiny banner on the Steam store:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TheStorytellersFestival2024][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40324791/835d729ecdb0f219c78dd2a28b51cc4a58444e69.png[/img][/url]

The timing couldn’t be better because, believe it or not, it’s now been[b] ONE WHOLE YEAR[/b] since the release of the FREERIDE demo!! It's been the joy of a lifetime to see over [b]THIRTY THOUSAND[/b] of you face judgment (big love to all you Clowns out there - you have a special place in our hearts 🤡). The team is so happy and grateful for the support, it really helps keep us motivated as we push on to the finish line!

[h1]Concept Art[/h1]
On that note – we’ve recently finished the story implementation of Act 2 and the Intermission, which is the biggest part of the game. 
Because you deserve a treat, here’s some brand new concept art from those areas:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40324791/187f4cfe8d94bf7c81e8f3765995ce1767284d40.png[/img]

[h1]Community Events[/h1]
I also wanted to share the results of last year’s [b]Act 2 Character Design[/b] contests on the Discord – you can see the concept art and how these characters look in the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40324791/178d21e5659df0d168c7ea18e6e2c841a9934f8b.png[/img]

Arcas beloved: [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40324791/1b69aab7020cdea84fbbd89c5a0e5b37d1651ce7.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40324791/1b69aab7020cdea84fbbd89c5a0e5b37d1651ce7.gif[/img][/url]
Mayumi & Sen, co-winners: [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40324791/18207dd21e06a310635023f5be8137bf4d86b551.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40324791/18207dd21e06a310635023f5be8137bf4d86b551.gif[/img][/url]


[h1]🚂✨✨✨ What's Next?[/h1]
We’re currently developing Act 3 and then will move on to Act 4 (aka, THE FINAL ACT!!). Also, I'm glad to confirm that we’re on schedule for release!! (Though we’ll keep our release date secret for just a while longer, sorryyy~)

Is there anything in particular you’d like to know about in FREERIDE? We’ve gotten this far by listening to and having amazing conversations with our community, so if there’s anything you want to say, please reach out here or on our other socials. 

As many of you know, we’ve had [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@flightyfelon?lang=en]TikTok[/url] for a good while now, but we recently decided to get back to posting on [url=https://twitter.com/FlightyFelGames]Twitter/X[/url] and we even started an [url=https://www.instagram.com/flightyfelongames/]Instagram[/url]/[url=https://www.threads.net/@flightyfelongames]Threads[/url]! 

That's it for this month’s post.
Thank you always and we’ll talk to you again soon!!

With love and without judgment (probably 👀), 

-The Flightyfelon Games Team  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40324791/c6bfaaf7f2f7146e3cf3c77ecdc604bb0692c804.gif[/img]
